verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Gemini Live as a natural, free-flowing spoken conversation. Gemini responds verbally without typing, and users can interrupt mid-response to add details or change topic, which covers the natural and real-time parts of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Gemini Live's conversational latency and quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: With Gemini Live, you can have a natural, free-flowing conversation with Gemini. You can even interrupt it like when you want to add more details or change the topic of the conversation.
Talk to Gemini without typing, and Gemini will respond back verbally.
